title: Qualify native DWF roadmap adoption
commitMessage: docs: qualify native DWF roadmap adoption

contribution.summary: Qualify the accepted product roadmap as native DWF execution authority by validating stable hierarchy/dependency mapping, the bounded RS001 historical exception, and payload-owned lifecycle progression for M0-W01-C02.
contribution.value: Turns the previously thin bootstrap into a faithful, machine-checkable executable roadmap while preserving product meaning and proving that every future run can advance DWF progress in the same controlled payload as its work.
debtChanges: The six pre-DWF C01 RED/GREEN/verification subtasks remain intentionally unbackfilled because their individual lifecycle transitions were never observed; this is documented rather than reconstructed.
The older French product-planning corpus remains canonical-language migration debt and must be translated from source with generated projections regenerated, not hand-edited.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS002 success, normalize the canonical planning corpus to English from its source and generated projections, then refine the next admissible M0-W02 provenance/licensing scope without starting AURA extraction.

achievements.achievement: The DWF adoption question is bounded against active guidance and the accepted product roadmap, with the authority split and mapping criteria fixed.
A bounded structural observation proves native-plan identity, hierarchy, dependency parity, RS001 evidence continuity, and the documented historical C01 exception.
The product-to-DWF mapping decision is recorded with its alternatives, limits, validation boundary, and continuation contract.
The native DWF roadmap mapping contract is qualified against the accepted product plan and durable RS001 evidence.
The DWF authority and recovery boundary is explicitly framed: no fabricated workflow authority, filler bootstrap run, or manual recovery choreography.
Observed preparation and validation contracts confirm read-only qualification, payload-owned progress mutation, and same-run correction semantics.
The adoption-boundary decision records generation versus validation responsibilities, correction/recovery ownership, and non-goals.
The DWF adoption limits and integration boundaries are qualified without authorizing external repository or provider work.
M0-W01-C02 qualifies the native DWF adoption and product mapping with a faithful executable roadmap projection and explicit historical exception.
The M0-W01 toolchain work package is complete: the reproducible .NET foundation and DWF adoption/mapping phases are both durably qualified.
